checkpoints.content:
{
  "sprint_goal": "Migrate customer profile data from PostgreSQL to MongoDB with zero downtime, ensuring data integrity, performance, and backward compatibility.",
  "tasks": [
    {
      "id": "T-001",
      "title": "Design MongoDB schema for flexible country-specific data",
      "description": "Create a MongoDB document schema allowing per-country subfields (e.g., Japan My Number, EU VAT ID) without fixed columns. Ensure compatibility with existing API models.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": []
    },
    {
      "id": "T-002",
      "title": "Define data mapping between PostgreSQL and MongoDB",
      "description": "Establish mapping logic between existing PostgreSQL columns and MongoDB document attributes, including normalization of NULL columns and transformation logic for nested country data.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 5.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-003",
      "title": "Implement CDC-based backfill process",
      "description": "Configure change data capture pipeline (Debezium or AWS DMS) to stream data from PostgreSQL to MongoDB, ensuring zero data loss and idempotent writes during backfill.",
      "category": "DevOps",
      "estimated_hours": 8.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-002"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-004",
      "title": "Develop dual-write mechanism for transitional period",
      "description": "Update API service to perform writes to both PostgreSQL and MongoDB during dual-write phase; implement transactional consistency checks and error logging.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 7.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-003"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-005",
      "title": "Set up MongoDB indexes for performance optimization",
      "description": "Create compound and country-specific indexes in MongoDB to achieve <50ms read latency (p95). Include index validation and performance benchmarking.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 3.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-006",
      "title": "Implement feature flag rollout for migration activation",
      "description": "Integrate feature flags (e.g., LaunchDarkly) to gradually route API traffic to MongoDB without downtime; monitor latency and errors during rollout.",
      "category": "DevOps",
      "estimated_hours": 4.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-004"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-007",
      "title": "Validate data parity between PostgreSQL and MongoDB",
      "description": "Develop and execute automated data validation script to compare all migrated records ensuring 100% data parity. Generate report before cutover.",
      "category": "Testing",
      "estimated_hours": 4.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-003", "T-004"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-008",
      "title": "Create rollback mechanism to revert to PostgreSQL",
      "description": "Implement automated rollback procedures and scripts that can redirect API reads/writes to PostgreSQL within one hour if MongoDB issues occur.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 3.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-004", "T-006"]
    }
  ],
  "risks": [
    {
      "id": "R-001",
      "description": "data inconsistency during dual-write phase leading to record mismatches",
      "severity": "High",
      "mitigation": "Implement idempotent writes, compare row counts every 12 hours, and add integrity checks in CDC pipeline"
    },
    {
      "id": "R-002",
      "description": "performance degradation on MongoDB due to inadequate indexing",
      "severity": "Medium",
      "mitigation": "Create compound indexes, execute load testing, optimize queries based on read-heavy access patterns"
    },
    {
      "id": "R-003",
      "description": "CDC pipeline failure causing incomplete backfill",
      "severity": "High",
      "mitigation": "Add monitoring alerts, retry failed batches automatically, maintain detailed audit trail of migrated records"
    },
    {
      "id": "R-004",
      "description": "rollback procedure exceeding one-hour SLA",
      "severity": "Medium",
      "mitigation": "Automate database switch scripts and pre-test rollback plan in staging environment"
    },
    {
      "id": "R-005",
      "description": "schema mismatch between API models and MongoDB documents",
      "severity": "Medium",
      "mitigation": "Integrate schema validation library and perform contract tests in CI pipeline"
    }
  ],
  "definition_of_done": [
    "MongoDB schema supports country-specific subfields",
    "CDC pipeline streams data with zero loss",
    "Dual-write tested and confirmed consistent",
    "MongoDB indexes validated for <50ms read latency",
    "Data parity validation script reports 100% match",
    "Feature-flag rollout achieves zero-downtime transition",
    "Rollback script verified within one hour execution window",
    "All documentation and validation reports submitted and reviewed"
  ],
  "total_estimated_hours": 40.0
}

{
  "test_strategy": "Adopt a hybrid testing approach covering backend services, data migration scripts, and API endpoints. Use Jest for unit and integration tests, Postman/Newman for API E2E validations, and custom parity and performance scripts for data validation. Focus on data correctness, dual-write consistency, CDC integrity, rollback reliability, and MongoDB performance targets. Implement continuous testing within CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and AWS ECS execution environments.",
  "test_cases": [
    {
      "id": "TC-001",
      "title": "Validate MongoDB schema structure supports country-specific subfields",
      "description": "Ensure MongoDB document model correctly stores customer data including nested country fields without requiring schema migrations.",
      "test_type": "Unit",
      "preconditions": ["MongoDB instance initialized", "Schema validation logic available"],
      "steps": ["Insert sample customer document with country-specific subfields", "Retrieve and validate schema structure"],
      "expected_result": "Document stored successfully with nested subfields supported without schema error",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-002",
      "title": "Test CDC-based backfill process for data parity and completeness",
      "description": "Verify CDC pipeline streams all PostgreSQL changes to MongoDB accurately ensuring zero data loss.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Debezium or AWS DMS configured", "Source PostgreSQL and target MongoDB collections connected"],
      "steps": ["Start CDC backfill process", "Add new record in PostgreSQL", "Check it appears in MongoDB within expected delay", "Compare record count and content"],
      "expected_result": "All PostgreSQL records and incremental changes are reflected in MongoDB with 100% parity",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-003",
      "title": "Dual-write operation consistency across PostgreSQL and MongoDB",
      "description": "Validate that customer data updates are consistently written to both databases during transitional phase.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Feature flag 'dual_write' enabled", "APIs operational"],
      "steps": ["Send POST /api/customers request", "Verify data in PostgreSQL and MongoDB", "Review logs for errors"],
      "expected_result": "Both databases contain identical customer data with no mismatched fields",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-004",
      "title": "Record parity verification before final cutover",
      "description": "Ensure validation script confirms all migrated records match PostgreSQL data before switching traffic fully to MongoDB.",
      "test_type": "E2E",
      "preconditions": ["All data migrated", "Validation endpoint available"],
      "steps": ["Trigger GET /api/migration/validate", "Check total records and mismatch count in response"],
      "expected_result": "Validation report shows zero mismatches and 'success' status",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-005",
      "title": "MongoDB index performance validation",
      "description": "Verify that indexed queries meet <50ms read latency at p95 under load.",
      "test_type": "Performance",
      "preconditions": ["Indexes created on country and name fields", "MongoDB cluster deployed"],
      "steps": ["Run load test simulating 5000 reads/sec", "Measure query latency"],
      "expected_result": "Query response latency is below 50ms for 95th percentile of requests",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-006",
      "title": "Feature flag rollout control for gradual migration activation",
      "description": "Validate toggling of feature flags progressively switches traffic from PostgreSQL to MongoDB without errors.",
      "test_type": "E2E",
      "preconditions": ["LaunchDarkly SDK configured", "Feature flag dashboard access granted"],
      "steps": ["Enable 'read_from_mongo' flag", "Run GET /api/customers/:id", "Disable flag and re-run test"],
      "expected_result": "Traffic routing changes according to flag status with zero downtime",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-007",
      "title": "Rollback mechanism operational verification",
      "description": "Check rollback procedure correctly reverts system traffic to PostgreSQL in case of errors within one hour.",
      "test_type": "E2E",
      "preconditions": ["Feature flags active", "Rollback route functional"],
      "steps": ["Trigger POST /api/migration/rollback with reason", "Verify traffic switched to PostgreSQL", "Confirm rollback logs completion timestamp"],
      "expected_result": "System redirects reads/writes to PostgreSQL within 1 hour, status 'success' returned",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-008",
      "title": "Negative test - MongoDB write failure handling during dual-write",
      "description": "Simulate MongoDB connection failure to ensure PostgreSQL writes still succeed and errors logged properly.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Dual-write feature enabled", "MongoDB service temporarily offline"],
      "steps": ["Perform POST /api/customers write", "Validate PostgreSQL record creation", "Review logs for Mongo error"],
      "expected_result": "PostgreSQL record created successfully, MongoDB error logged, system continues without crash",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-009",
      "title": "Negative test - Schema validation failure on invalid data",
      "description": "Ensure invalid input data is rejected according to JSON schema validation rules.",
      "test_type": "Unit",
      "preconditions": ["Schema validator active"],
      "steps": ["Send POST /api/customers with missing required fields", "Capture response"],
      "expected_result": "System returns 400 or validation error without data insertion",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-010",
      "title": "Security test for improper access during migration",
      "description": "Confirm RBAC and TLS configuration prevent unauthorized database access during migration period.",
      "test_type": "Security",
      "preconditions": ["MongoDB Atlas roles configured", "AWS Secrets Manager in use"],
      "steps": ["Attempt unauthorized connection", "Inspect access logs"],
      "expected_result": "Connection denied and properly logged, no sensitive data exposed",
      "priority": "High"
    }
  ],
  "test_data_requirements": [
    "Sample customer records for multiple countries (JP, EU, US)",
    "Large dataset simulation (2M records) for performance testing",
    "Invalid schema payloads for negative test scenarios",
    "CDC simulation events for testing data stream",
    "Feature flag configurations for staged rollout"
  ],
  "automation_approach": "Leverage Jest for unit and integration tests with coverage tracking, Newman for API E2E testing, and custom Node.js parity and performance scripts integrated into CI/CD. Automate migration validation and rollback scenarios using AWS ECS scheduled tasks. Continuous monitoring via CloudWatch integrated with GitHub Actions pipeline for nightly parity verification.",
  "coverage_goals": "90% code coverage across services, 100% validation of migrated records for data parity, 95% API endpoint test coverage, all critical paths (dual-write, rollback, CDC, feature toggling) tested across environments including staging and production simulations."
}

{
  "summary": "The release focuses on migrating 2 million customer profiles from PostgreSQL to MongoDB to support flexible schema needs for global expansion. This initiative eliminates costly schema migrations, improves agility for international compliance, and achieves zero downtime through dual-write and feature-flag control. Successful implementation will reduce monthly maintenance overhead by 20+ hours, enhance scalability, and deliver faster data access across regions.",
  "scope_overview": "Migration includes PostgreSQL-to-MongoDB data transfer via CDC backfill, dual-write integration, validation parity checks, performance index configuration, and rollback procedures. The backward-compatible API ensures transparent transition for customers. Deliverables include tested MongoDB schema supporting country-specific data, performance under 50ms p95, and a verified rollback capability within one hour.",
  "key_risks": [
    "Potential data inconsistency during dual-write phase could lead to record mismatches",
    "MongoDB performance degradation if indexing strategy proves insufficient under global load"
  ],
  "test_readiness": "Testing readiness is high with comprehensive QA coverage across schema flexibility, CDC accuracy, performance validation, dual-write consistency, and rollback reliability. Automated parity checks and load tests confirm near-production reliability with CI/CD integration ensuring continuous validation within AWS ECS.",
  "recommendations": [
    "Perform a full load test and parity validation before enabling 100% MongoDB traffic",
    "Maintain rollback readiness for the first week post-cutover with active monitoring and automated alerts"
  ],
  "next_steps": [
    "Complete dual-write testing and full data parity validation before switching production reads",
    "Conduct post-migration performance benchmarking and finalize documentation for index optimization review"
  ]
}
